claims.claim: Wealthsimple launched Penny AI assistant on November 6, 2026 at its Presents event in Toronto.
claims.episode_span: The launch occurred at the Wealthsimple Presents event in Toronto on November 6, 2026, alongside a dozen other product announcements.
claims.source_title: Wealthsimple launches AI banking assistant that can help move money, place trades
claims.supporting_quote: The company announced a dozen new products at its Wealthsimple Presents event in Toronto on Thursday, including Penny, its new AI assistant.

claims.claim: The Bank of Canada and Government of Canada renewed the monetary policy framework on November 5, 2026, reaffirming the 2% inflation target.
claims.episode_span: The Bank of Canada and federal government renewed the monetary policy framework, reaffirming the 2% inflation target with added focus on supply-side shocks.
claims.source_title: Joint Statement of the Government of Canada and the Bank of Canada on the Renewal of the Monetary Policy Framework
claims.supporting_quote: The Government of Canada and the Bank of Canada jointly review and renew the Bank’s monetary policy framework every five years.

claims.claim: S&P/TSX composite closed at 35,605.27 after falling 736.13 points on November 5, 2026.
claims.episode_span: The S&P/TSX composite fell 736.13 points to close at 35,605.27, led lower by technology and base metals.
claims.source_title: S&P/TSX composite down more than 700 points, U.S. stock markets also fall
claims.supporting_quote: The S&P/TSX composite index was down 736.13 points at 35,605.27 a day after stock markets in Canada and the United States posted big gains following the U.S. midterm elections that saw Democrats take control of Congress.

claims.claim: Governor Macklem and Senior Deputy Governor Rogers appear before the Senate Committee on November 5, 2026 at 10:30 ET.
claims.episode_span: Governor Tiff Macklem and Senior Deputy Governor Carolyn Rogers will appear before the Standing Senate Committee on Banking, Commerce and the Economy on November 5, 2026, to discuss these lessons, with the opening statement published at 10:30 ET.
claims.source_title: Governor Macklem and Senior Deputy Governor Rogers to Appear Before Senate Committee
claims.supporting_quote: On Thursday, November 5, 2026, the Governor of the Bank of Canada, Tiff Macklem, will appear before the Standing Senate Committee on Banking, Commerce and the Economy.
